name: ahau-v2
description: Backend-agnostic data-access contract for Āhau v2

scripts.test: npm run check:manifest && npm run build && node --test dist && vitest run && node scripts/check-contract-coverage.mjs --ci && node scripts/check-conformance-coverage.mjs --ci
scripts.build:happ: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && hc dna pack dnas/ahau/workdir && hc app pack workdir
scripts.test:conductor: npm run build:happ && hc dna pack dnas/ahau/test/workdir && hc app pack workdir/rogue && rm -rf dist && npm run build && files=$(find dist -name '*.conductor.js') && { [ -n "$files" ] || { echo 'no conductor tests found in dist' >&2; exit 1; }; } && node --test --test-concurrency=1 $files
scripts.conductor: npm run build:happ && hc sandbox clean && echo pass | hc sandbox --piped -f=4444 generate workdir/ahau.happ --app-id ahau --run=8888 network mem
